title: M3M India — Depth & Specificity Research
content:
M3M India's flagship projects include completed developments like M3M 84 Market, Broadway, Latitude, Iconic & Sky Suites, and ongoing premium developments such as M3M Crown, Antalya Hills, Capital Walk, Sky City, Route 65 & The Cullinan. In 2026, M3M India launched M3M Paragon57, a retail project in Delhi-NCR, and unveiled M3M Black Circle, a private, invitation-only platform extending branded homeownership with exclusive access and curated experiences, debuting in Paris, France. M3M India's business areas include real estate development, luxury residential development, commercial real estate development, and retail property development.

In this video, we cover:
• M3M’s vision and brand philosophy
• Completed landmark projects like M3M 84 Market, Broadway, Latitude, Iconic & Sky Suites
• Ongoing premium developments such as M3M Crown, Antalya Hills, Capital Walk, Sky City, Route 65 & The Cullinan
• How M3M projects go beyond buildings to create lifestyle ecosystems
• The role of international & Indian brands across M3M developments

The sources indicate that M3M India focuses on residential and commercial real estate development, including luxury residential apartments, serviced apartments, retail shopping centers, and office spaces. M3M India's business model includes both B2B and B2C operations. The company emphasizes corporate transparency and standardized valuations through its M3M Assured program, which aims to provide an organized marketplace for real estate transactions in India. However, specific pricing models and price positioning in the real estate market are not provided in the sources.

M3M has a stellar track record of offering attractive rental yields and assured returns during the construction phase. For the savvy investor, this means a steady stream of passive income from Day 1. With the marketplace model, these returns become even more attractive as the "exit" is already planned, allowing for a clear calculation of the Internal Rate of Return (IRR).

### 3. A Boost for Channel Partners [...] ### Why "Organized Marketplace" Matters

Most real estate transactions in India happen in the "unorganized" sector. Information is asymmetrical, and trust is often thin. M3M Assured brings corporate transparency to the secondary market. It provides:

Standardized Valuations: No more guesswork on property rates.

Verified Documentation: Seamless transfers within the M3M ecosystem.

Speed of Execution: Eliminating the months-long wait for the "right buyer." [...] At its core, M3M Assured operates on a simple yet powerful philosophy: "Buy from Us, Sell to Us." In a traditional real estate cycle, a buyer is often left at the mercy of local brokers and fluctuating market demand when they wish to liquidate their asset. M3M Assured changes this narrative by creating a closed-loop, organized ecosystem. ## About M3M India

M3M India is a real estate developer that focuses on residential and commercial properties. The company offers services including the development of residential projects, commercial spaces, retail outlets, and serviced apartments, along with property leasing services. M3M India's projects include various designs and amenities, serving the luxury segment of the real estate market. It was founded in 2007 and is based in Gurugram, India.
